w144 is done and committed as 6d5851d: `initiative-round` now appends its ledger line with `work note` to `.shop/work/<initiative>/ledger.md`. The work-item has no scenario, so there was no red run and its review is the judge. The final run, `python3 -m pytest -q --work-item w144`, gave 142 passed and 1 skipped. `tests/scripts/test_agents.py` and `tests/scenarios/test_supervision.py` also passed, and `tools size --limit 300` printed nothing. I did not run the whole suite.

- **`agents/initiative-round.md`:**
  - The ledger section now runs `work note <initiative> "<line>"` after the round's own commit and before it replies.
  - The initiative's name comes from the dispatch, or from the directory of the `Capability-proposal:` path in a `work run` brief.
  - The line must be a single line.
  - If the round has no initiative name, or `work note` refuses the line, it replies with its work and says the line was not written.
- **`scripts/supervise_worker.py`:** each round kind (`apply`, `formulate`) can now run `work note` and no other `work` subcommand. Without this, a round started by `work run` could not have run `work note` at all. I rewrote the comment above `STAGE_SCRIPTS` to match.
- **`skills/integrating-a-proposal/SKILL.md` and `skills/formulating-features/SKILL.md`:** their dispatch steps now give the round the initiative's name, and their `initiative-round` paragraphs say the round ends with its ledger line.

Two cases are left unchosen, since neither the scenarios nor the capability's Behaviour lines cover them:
- Whether a round that ends `BLOCKED` still appends a line.
- The empty-text defect in `work note`, which I did not fix.

The plan contained no code. No tests were changed.

The report is `.shop/scratch/3-implement/report.md`.
